s1.description: Opening: retrieval warm-up, outcomes and the 3-hour plan

s2.description: Block 1: Galerkin weighted residual and integration by parts for the vector problem, and the strain–displacement matrix B

s3.description: Block 2: the k34 derivation in three steps, the twelve closed-form entries and the numerical stiffness matrix of the cantilever element

s4.description: Block 3: equivalent nodal loads from edge tractions and body forces, and the global load vector of the cantilever

s5.description: Block 4: the dof map, scatter-add assembly of the 18-by-18 system, imposition of the fixed-edge conditions and the reduced system

s6.description: Block 5: mesh convergence of the tip deflection, the beam-theory check, and why the bilinear element is too stiff in bending

s7.description: Block 6: the plane-stress MATLAB script by diff against the heat-transfer script, exit ticket and preparation for Plane Stress Part 3
